entry.title: 2019-06-12.md
entry.content: We’re back! After a few weeks of server outage, magpu.com is back in action, with a revamped look and a better way to play audio. We’re using modern tooling that makes for easier updates. Thanks for visiting – check out some tunes while you’re here!

entry.title: 2010-04-12.md
entry.content:
Happy 12th anniversary, Magpu!

If Cliff hadn’t spent the evening playing Monk tunes and fiddling with the Moog, he might have uploaded the 2002-04-12 show for your listening pleasure. The good intentions were there, anyway. The featured show hasn’t changed in quite a while, so watch this space for something new before too long.

Y’all’re jazz.
